title: model-catalog: add capability flags, pricing/limits, and OpenAI-compat streaming + structured output
author: Sofia Martinez
description:
Motivation: customers need a single model-catalog endpoint that exposes model capability filters, explicit compatibility flags (OpenAI-compat, streaming, function-calling, structured-output), and pricing/limits metadata to drive routing and UI. This PR centralizes capability metadata, surfaces pricing/limits fields, and updates the OpenAI compatibility layer so streaming + structured output function-calling is discoverable and reliably routed.

Summary of changes: consolidated capability schema for models; added `capabilities` flags (openai_compat, streaming, function_calling, structured_output, embeddings, chat); exposed `pricing` and `limits` at model listing level; added server-side filter query params for capabilities (capabilities=streaming,function_calling) and min/max price; extended OpenAI-compat middleware to advertise supported streaming modes and structured output serialization profiles; added safeguards for fallback routing when requested capability is not available.

Compatibility notes: existing clients will continue to receive legacy `model_type` and `tags` fields. New fields are additive. OpenAI-compat layer continues to translate redwood API shapes to OpenAI-compatible endpoints, but callers requesting function-calling + structured_output should check model `capabilities` before routing to avoid runtime 422s.

Testing and rollout: added unit + integration tests for capability filters, pricing/limits parsing, and OpenAI-compat streaming handshake. Ran load tests with perf-canary; streaming stability tests were flaky initially, fixed by introducing request-level backpressure window and tighter KV cache eviction for long-lived streams. Rollout plan: feature-flagged on `model_catalog_v2` behind gradual rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with metrics for filter-select success rate and fallback occurrences.

Checklist:
- [x] API schema and docs updated
- [x] End-to-end tests for filters and pricing
- [x] OpenAI-compat layer updated for streaming + structured output
- [x] Perf canary verified at 50% load
- [x] Migration notes and developer docs added (redwood/docs/openai_compat.md)

Related: Linear ENG-4821 (model catalog capability flags), ENG-4902 (OpenAI-compat streaming fixes).

review_comments: Jun Wei (2026-01-25): Can you clarify the semantics of `limits.max_tokens_per_request` vs runtime truncation? If a model advertises lower limits we should reject earlier to avoid wasted compute.
Sofia Martinez (2026-01-26): Agree — added pre-check in handlers.py that returns 422 with a clear message when requested tokens > limits.max_tokens_per_request.
Morgan Blake (2026-01-28): Streaming proxy change looks good, but the initial backpressure window of 500ms caused tail latency spikes in canary; can we make it adaptive?
Sofia Martinez (2026-01-29): Switched to adaptive window with heuristics based on in-flight token count; updated tests and canary results improved.
Arjun Singh (2026-02-02): Need a migration note calling out deprecation plan for `tags.streaming=true` users — prefer `capabilities.streaming` now.
Sofia Martinez (2026-02-03): Added migration notes to docs and a deprecation lint warning for publishers still using the old tag.
Morgan Blake (2026-02-20): CI flake on test_openai_compat_streaming.py fixed by mocking a long-lived connection; approving pending CI.
release_notes: Expose model capability flags and pricing/limits on model catalog API. Add capability-based filtering and improve OpenAI compatibility for streaming + structured output. Backward compatible; migration notes included.
